cards.audioText: Do you like sports? Who is your favorite sport star?
cards.audioTextZh: 喜欢运动吗？你最喜欢的运动明星是谁？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I like basketball, and my favorite basketball star is Yaoming.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我喜欢打篮球，我最喜欢的篮球明星是姚明。

cards.audioText: Do you like sports? / What is your favorite sport game? Who is your favorite sport star?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢运动吗？/你最喜欢的体育运动是什么？/你最喜欢的运动员是谁？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I like sports. I like playing football/basketball/badminton/volleyball. / I like running/swimming/cycling/skiing. My favorite sport star is Michael Jordan/Kobe Bryant/Messi/ Cristiano Ronaldo.
No, I don't like sports, I prefer to stay at home and play games.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我喜欢运动。我喜欢踢足球/打篮球/打羽毛球/打排球。/我喜欢跑步/游泳/骑自行车/滑雪。我最喜欢的体育明星是乔丹/科比/梅西/C罗。

不，我不喜欢运动，我更喜欢呆在家里玩游戏。

cards.audioText: Do you like music? / What type (kind) of music do you like best? / Who's your favorite singer? / What's your favorite song?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢音乐吗？/你最喜欢哪种类型的音乐？/你最喜欢的歌手是谁？/你最喜欢哪首歌？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I like music/listening to music. I like pop music/rock/folk music/jazz/hiphop. My favorite singer is Michael Jackson/Eason Chan. My favorite song is Earth Song/Sleep Alone/Love.
cards.referenceTextZh: 嗯，我喜欢音乐/听音乐。我喜欢流行/摇滚/民谣/爵士/嘻哈音乐。我最喜欢的歌手是迈克尔•杰克逊/陈奕迅。我最喜欢听的歌是Earth Song/ Sleep Alone/ Love。

cards.audioText: What do you like to do in your spare time?
cards.audioTextZh: 闲暇时间你喜欢做什么？
cards.referenceText: In my spare time, I like playing basketball, running, swimming or playing computer games.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在闲暇时间，我喜欢打篮球，跑步，游泳，或玩游戏。

cards.audioText: Do you like to go to the theatre/concert? / How often do you go to the cinema? / What's your favorite TV program/TV play?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢去电影院/音乐会吗？/你多久去一次电影院？/你最喜欢的电视节目/电视剧是什么？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I like to go to the theatre/concert. I go to the cinema once a month. My favorite TV program is CCTV-5/talk show.
No, I don't like to go to the theatre/concert. I don't like to go to the cinema, because I prefer to watch movies at home.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我喜欢去影院/音乐会。我一个月去一次电影院。我最喜欢的电视节目是中央-5体育频道/脱口秀。
我不喜欢去影院/听音乐会。我不喜欢去电影院，我更喜欢在家里看电影。

cards.audioText: What type of music do you like best?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢什么样的音乐？
cards.referenceText: I like pop music.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我喜欢流行音乐。

cards.audioText: What do you like to do in your spare time? Do you like to spend spare time with your family?
cards.audioTextZh: 你空闲时间喜欢做什么？空闲时，你喜欢跟家人一起吗？
cards.referenceText: In my spare time, I like to do sports/go shopping/play games at home. Yes, I like to spend my spare time with my family. It's precious time for me to be with my family.
cards.referenceTextZh: 空闲时，我喜欢锻炼身体/购物/在家玩游戏。我空闲时间喜欢和家人一起度过，对我来说，和家人一起的时间是非常宝贵的。

cards.audioText: Do you like reading books/novels? What is your favorite novel?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢看书/看小说吗？你最喜欢的小说是什么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I like reading novels. My favorite novel is The Ordinary World.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我喜欢看小说。我最喜欢的小说是《平凡的世界》。

cards.audioText: What's your favorite way to relax after work? What kind of outdoor activities do you like?
cards.audioTextZh: 下班后你最喜欢的放松方式什么？你喜欢什么样的室外活动？
cards.referenceText: Sometimes I like doing sports, while sometimes I like listening to music to relax after work. I like to take a walk with my family.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我有的时候喜欢去锻炼，有的时候喜欢下了班听听音乐来放松心情。我喜欢和家人一起出去散步。

cards.audioText: How often do you go to cinema?
cards.audioTextZh: 多久去看一次电影？
cards.referenceText: About once a month.
cards.referenceTextZh: 大概每个月去一次。

cards.audioText: What is your favorite TV program?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢的电视节目是什么？
cards.referenceText: My favorite is Talk Show, I like it because it's interesting and humorous.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢脱口秀节目，因为有意思，也很幽默。

cards.audioText: Would you like to visit some duty-free shops at airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢去机场的免税店吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, when the flight schedule is not very tight, I would like to visit duty-free shops which selling a large selection of tax-free goods with local characteristic, and buy some real bargains.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当航班日程不是很紧时我喜欢逛免税店，店内会有大量带有当地特色的免税商品，我可以买到物美价廉的商品。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy shopping online?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢网上购物吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I enjoy shopping online. I often use Taobao because many goods are affordable and delivery is fast.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢网上购物。我经常使用淘宝，因为许多商品价格实惠，而且配送很快。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy listening to music?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢听音乐吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I enjoy listening to music.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢听音乐。

cards.audioText: What do you like to do when you are not flying?
cards.audioTextZh: 不飞行时你喜欢做什么？
cards.referenceText: When I am not flying, I like to cook. Trying new recipes and preparing good meals is a relaxing way to spend my time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不飞行时，我喜欢做饭。尝试新食谱并做出可口的饭菜，是一种令人放松的休闲方式。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy sports or outdoor activities?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢运动或户外活动吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I enjoy sports. Swimming and running are my favorites because they help me build strength.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢运动。游泳和跑步是我最喜欢的运动，因为它们能帮助我增强体质。

cards.audioText: Which website do you visit most often, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最常访问哪个网站？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I visit Taobao most often. I use it for online shopping because many goods are affordable and delivery is fast.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最常访问淘宝。我用它进行网上购物，因为许多商品价格实惠，而且配送很快。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy traveling?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢旅行吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I enjoy traveling.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢旅行。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy reading?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢阅读吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I enjoy reading.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢阅读。

cards.audioText: What kind of music do you like best?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪种类型的音乐？
cards.referenceText: I like light music best. Its gentle melodies and soothing rhythms help me relax after training and concentrate while reading or thinking. Cheerful light music can also improve my mood.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢轻音乐。轻柔的旋律和舒缓的节奏能让我在训练后放松，也有助于我在阅读或思考时集中注意力。欢快的轻音乐还能改善我的心情。

cards.audioText: What is your favorite sport?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪项运动？
cards.referenceText: Swimming and running are my favorite sports. They help me build strength.
cards.referenceTextZh: 游泳和跑步是我最喜欢的运动，它们能帮助我增强体质。

cards.audioText: How often do you go to the cinema?
cards.audioTextZh: 你多久去一次电影院？
cards.referenceText: I go to the cinema about twice a month.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我大约每月去电影院两次。

cards.audioText: How have computers changed people's lives?
cards.audioTextZh: 电脑如何改变了人们的生活？
cards.referenceText: Computers have become an essential part of daily life. People now use them for work, entertainment, games, and finding information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 电脑已经成为日常生活中不可或缺的一部分。人们现在用电脑工作、娱乐、玩游戏和查找信息。

cards.audioText: Have you ever traveled abroad?
cards.audioTextZh: 你出国旅行过吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I have. I have travelled to Australia, the United States, Japan, and South Africa.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我去过澳大利亚、美国、日本和南非。

cards.audioText: What hobbies do you have?
cards.audioTextZh: 你有哪些爱好？
cards.referenceText: I enjoy reading, especially books about aviation history. It broadens my knowledge of the aviation industry.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我喜欢阅读，尤其喜欢航空史方面的书籍。这能拓宽我对航空业的了解。

cards.audioText: Who is your favorite singer?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢的歌手是谁？
cards.referenceText: My favorite singer is Jay Chou. I find his music touching and beautiful.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢的歌手是周杰伦。我觉得他的音乐动人而优美。

cards.audioText: What type of movie do you like best?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪种类型的电影？
cards.referenceText: I do not have just one favorite type. I enjoy action films, comedies, horror films, romances, documentaries, and cartoons. For me, the quality of the movie matters more than its genre.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我并非只喜欢一种类型。我喜欢动作片、喜剧片、恐怖片、爱情片、纪录片和动画片。对我来说，电影本身的质量比类型更重要。

cards.audioText: Who is your favorite athlete?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢的运动员是谁？
cards.referenceText: My favorite athlete is Kobe Bryant. I admire him very much.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢的运动员是科比·布莱恩特，我非常敬佩他。

cards.audioText: Who is your favorite movie star?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢的电影明星是谁？
cards.referenceText: My favorite movie star is Tom Cruise. I think he is handsome and charming, and I especially enjoy his performance in Mission: Impossible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢的电影明星是汤姆·克鲁斯。我觉得他英俊而有魅力，尤其喜欢他在《碟中谍》中的表演。

cards.audioText: What is your favorite book?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪本书？
cards.referenceText: My favorite book is To Kill a Mockingbird because it is full of wisdom.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢的书是《杀死一只知更鸟》，因为书中充满智慧。

cards.audioText: What's your favorite movie?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪部电影？
cards.referenceText: My favorite movie is Sully. It tells the story of Captain Sully's successful river ditching after a bird strike. I see him as a hero.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢的电影是《萨利机长》。它讲述了萨利机长在遭遇鸟击后成功迫降河面的故事。我把他视为英雄。

cards.audioText: How often do you use a computer?
cards.audioTextZh: 你多久使用一次电脑？
cards.referenceText: I use a computer often.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我经常使用电脑。

cards.audioText: How often do you play sports?
cards.audioTextZh: 你多久参加一次体育运动？
cards.referenceText: I usually play sports two or three times a week. I enjoy running and playing badminton because they improve my fitness and help me relax after studying or flight training. I reduce the intensity before an important flight so that I am properly rested.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我通常每周运动两到三次。我喜欢跑步和打羽毛球，因为这些运动既能改善体能，也能让我在学习或飞行训练后放松下来。重要飞行前，我会降低运动强度，确保自己得到充分休息。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy watching movies?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢看电影吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I enjoy watching movies because they allow me to experience different stories.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢看电影，因为电影能让我体验不同的故事。
